title: Exploring protein-ligand binding affinity prediction with electron density-based geometric deep learning
authors: Clemens Isert; Kenneth Atz; Sereina Riniker; Gisbert Schneider
one_liner_zh: 该文用电子密度键临界点结合几何深度学习预测蛋白-配体结合亲和力，对象为折叠蛋白与小分子，非IDP/PPI，但物理表征与AI建模思路对互作机制建模有部分可迁移启发。
abstract: Rational structure-based drug design relies on accurate predictions of protein-ligand binding affinity from structural molecular information. Some of the existing deep learning approaches for this purpose have been criticized for insufficiently capturing the underlying physical interactions between ligands and their macromolecular targets. Herein, we propose to include bond-critical points based on the electron density of a protein-ligand complex as a fundamental physical representation of protein-ligand interactions. Employing a geometric deep learning model, we explore the usefulness of these bond-critical points to predict absolute binding affinities of protein-ligand complexes, benchmark model performance against existing methods, and provide a critical analysis of this new approach. The models achieved root-mean-squared errors of 1.4-1.8 log units on the PDBbind dataset, and 1.0-1.7 log units on the PDE10A dataset, not indicating significant advantages over benchmark methods. The relationship between intermolecular electron density and corresponding binding affinity was analyzed, and Pearson correlation coefficients r > 0.7 were obtained for several macromolecular targets.
abstract_zh: 基于结构的理性药物设计依赖于从结构分子信息中准确预测蛋白质-配体结合亲和力。为此目的而设计的一些现有深度学习方法因未能充分捕捉配体与其大分子靶标之间的潜在物理相互作用而受到批评。在此，我们提出将基于蛋白质-配体复合物电子密度的键临界点纳入作为蛋白质-配体相互作用的基本物理表征。利用几何深度学习模型，我们探索了这些键临界点在预测蛋白质-配体复合物绝对结合亲和力方面的实用性，将模型性能与现有方法进行基准比较，并对这一新方法进行了批判性分析。模型在PDBbind数据集上实现了1.4-1.8对数单位的均方根误差，在PDE10A数据集上实现了1.0-1.7对数单位的均方根误差，未显示出相对于基准方法的显著优势。分析了分子间电子密度与相应结合亲和力之间的关系，并对多个大分子靶标获得了皮尔逊相关系数r > 0.7的结果。
